framework.purpose: Observe-only dual-path sleeve lab: widest earliest/latest markers with capital_status tags (on_book / off_book / never_funded). NAV vs ^FTSE stays on the capital book; sleeve metrics stratify by tag.

recording.earliest_entry: First pass on near-buy (hold + conviction >= pre_buy floor 0.28) or buy-tier — whichever comes first
recording.latest_exit: Momentum-grace end + post_grace_extra_days (~1 month); fallback if grace never arms: leave wide zone × exit_confirm_screens + post_grace_extra_days; or hard avoid
recording.best_policy: Nested counterfactual inside the wide episode — not the freeze gate

capital_status.on_book: Crossed threshold and currently (or once) held in the paper fund
capital_status.off_book: Capital sold while the experimental episode was still open
capital_status.never_funded: Crossed threshold but never received paper capital

framework.evidence_validity: Additive observe store — does not invalidate prior NAV / decision-review / exit_shadow marks. Those remain valid for what they measured. Do not back-label historical NAV as dual-path sleeve evidence.
